name: rc-shell
description: Riot Commander Electron companion shell (Phase 1) + in-game overlay (Phase 2/3): a frameless always-on-top window loading RC_ORIGIN, surface-switching companion <-> transparent overlay by mode_key with a global hotkey toggle. Phase 4: ACTIVE-mode glow indicator + overlay position/panel-set persistence. Phase 5: electron-updater on stable/dev GitHub Release channels. Vanguard-safe: DWM compositor window only, no capture / memory / injection.
